description: Price a European call and put with Black-Scholes-Merton and get delta, gamma, vega (per vol point), theta (per day), rho, d1, d2 and the probability of ending in the money; or give a market price and get the implied volatility. Inputs: spot, strike, expiry date or days, volatility, interest rate and dividend or funding yield in percent. Pure arithmetic, no data source. Use for crypto, stock or FX options, to price a quote or size a hedge. Example: spot=100, strike=100. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

days.description: Days to expiry (default 30), or give expiry or years

dividend.description: Dividend, funding or borrow yield in percent per year (default 0)

price.description: A market option price: returns the implied volatility

rate.description: Risk-free rate in percent per year, e.g. 5 for 5% (default 0)

type.description: call or put, for the implied volatility (default call)

vol.description: Annual volatility in percent, e.g. 20 (default 50); not needed with price

years.description: Years to expiry, instead of days

name: options_price
title: Option pricing, Black-Scholes and Greeks
